questions.question: In Jesus' parable of the farmer sowing seed, what came and devoured the seed that fell along the path?
Jesus explained that some people are like seed along the path. What happens as soon as they hear the word?

answers.text: Satan comes and takes it away
They argue it out of their heads

questions.question: Jesus said the kingdom of God is like a tiny mustard seed. What does that seed grow to be?

answers.text: The largest of all garden plants
A small bush in the corner

questions.question: Jesus taught the crowds only in parables. What did He do privately with His own disciples?

answers.text: Asked them to explain it to Him
